title: Count error log entries
prompt: Count lines whose second whitespace field is exactly ERROR.

title: Unique users
prompt: Print sorted unique values after user= in an application log.

title: Directory file size
prompt: Sum sizes of regular files recursively, preserving paths with spaces.

title: Find text files
prompt: Print relative paths of *.txt regular files under a directory, sorted.

title: Validate a TCP port
prompt: Print VALID/exit 0 for decimal integers 1–65535, else INVALID/exit 1.

title: Count requests per IP
prompt: Count IPs from access log, sorted count descending then IP ascending.

title: Compute mean latency
prompt: Print mean of latency_ms=N records to one decimal, or 0.0 if empty.

title: Atomic local copy
prompt: Copy file with destination-adjacent temporary file and rename; reject bad sources.

title: Verify SHA256 manifest
prompt: Check sha256sum-format manifest relative to its directory; print OK/FAIL.

title: Latency p90 nearest rank
prompt: Print 90th percentile (nearest rank) of integer values, or 0 if empty.

title: Find failed units
prompt: List failed service names from name<TAB>status rows, sorted; else NO_FAILURES.

title: Rotate log without overwrite
prompt: Rename source log to new archive (never overwrite), create empty source.
